title: aster biennis
intro: Aster biennis, commonly known as tall white aster or white lettuce, is a flowering plant species in the daisy family. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The plant is reported to have health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its use in treating conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and skin irritations. The bioactive constituents of Aster biennis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
